) format("woff2");font-display:block}
.sheet[data-font="assinatura"] .hero-title{font-family:"Pop assinatura"!important;font-size:8.0cqw!important;letter-spacing:-.025em!important;line-height:1.02!important}
@font-face{font-family:"Pop corrida";src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2");font-display:block}
.sheet[data-font="corrida"] .hero-title{font-family:"Pop corrida"!important;font-size:6.8cqw!important;letter-spacing:-.025em!important;line-height:1.02!important}

.sheet[data-font="grafite"] .hero-title{text-transform:uppercase!important;transform:rotate(-2deg)!important;transform-origin:left center!important}
.sheet[data-font="assinatura"] .hero-title{font-weight:normal!important;letter-spacing:-.055em!important}
.sheet[data-font="corrida"] .hero-title{font-style:italic!important;letter-spacing:-.045em!important}
</style><style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Racing+Sans+One&amp;display=swap');
.sheet[data-font="racing"] .hero-title{font-family:'Racing Sans One',Impact,sans-serif!important;font-weight:400!important;font-style:normal!important;font-size:7.3cqw!important;line-height:.94!important;letter-spacing:-.035em!important;transform:skew(-5deg)!important;}
</style><style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Concert+One&amp;family=Permanent+Marker&amp;family=Racing+Sans+One&amp;family=Sigmar+One&amp;display=swap');

.sheet[data-font="marker"] .hero-title{font-family:'Permanent Marker',cursive!important;font-weight:400!important;font-style:normal!important;font-size:6.7cqw!important;letter-spacing:-.035em!important;line-height:1.03!important;transform:rotate(-2deg)!important}
.sheet[data-font="concert"] .hero-title{font-family:'Concert One',sans-serif!important;font-weight:400!important;font-style:normal!important;font-size:7.1cqw!important;letter-spacing:-.025em!important;line-height:1.02!important;transform:none!important}
</style><style>
/* V3.1 — PALETAS COMPLETAS: o seletor Cor controla a arte inteira.
   Estrutura, métricas, fotos e medalha original preservadas. */
.sheet[data-color="rosa"]{--accent:#ff55b5;--accent-light:#ffb9e8;--deep:#13051f;--mid:#451054;--panel:#51105d;--panel2:#230c36;--glow:#f43ae5;--stroke:#f75dfa;--muted:#ff92ff}
.sheet[data-color="lilas"]{--accent:#b58aff;--accent-light:#e3d2ff;--deep:#0d0825;--mid:#33216d;--panel:#382269;--panel2:#171437;--glow:#9661ff;--stroke:#a98bff;--muted:#bda7ff}
.sheet[data-color="azul"]{--accent:#46c6ff;--accent-light:#c6f1ff;--deep:#041728;--mid:#103f74;--panel:#123c6d;--panel2:#0a1d38;--glow:#21a5fa;--stroke:#4cb9ff;--muted:#79d5ff}
.sheet[data-color="turquesa"]{--accent:#4af5bd;--accent-light:#b9ffe8;--deep:#041c1c;--mid:#0c504d;--panel:#0d4d48;--panel2:#092e31;--glow:#20e6bb;--stroke:#41dfbf;--muted:#7fffe0}
.sheet[data-color="laranja"]{--accent:#ffad49;--accent-light:#ffe0ac;--deep:#261006;--mid:#6d2f12;--panel:#673016;--panel2:#321b13;--glow:#ff8e2b;--stroke:#ffb05b;--muted:#ffd083}
.sheet{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 72% 14%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--glow) 40%,transparent),transparent 33%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 6% 57%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--mid) 75%,transparent),transparent 43%),linear-gradient(120deg,var(--mid),var(--deep) 67%,var(--mid))!important}
.sheet:before{background:linear-gradient(148deg,transparent 10%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 20%,transparent) 11%,transparent 14%),linear-gradient(152deg,transparent 91%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 20%,transparent) 94%,transparent 97%)!important}
.sheet .topline,.sheet .underline{background:var(--accent)!important}
.sheet .slogan,.sheet .footer .motto{border-left-color:var(--accent)!important}
.sheet .logo{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 7px var(--glow))!important}
.sheet .portrait{border-color:var(--muted)!important;background:var(--mid)!important;box-shadow:0 0 1.4cqw #fff,0 0 3.3cqw var(--glow),0 0 6cqw var(--glow)!important}
.sheet .pill{background:linear-gradient(105deg,var(--mid),var(--glow))!important;box-shadow:0 0 1cqw var(--glow)!important}
.sheet .box,.sheet .hero-metric,.sheet .route,.sheet .summary{border-color:var(--stroke)!important;background:linear-gradient(113deg,var(--panel),var(--panel2) 52%,var(--panel))!important;box-shadow:0 0 1.5cqw color-mix(in srgb,var(--glow) 70%,transparent),inset 0 0 1.4cqw color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 18%,transparent)!important}
.sheet .metric{border-color:var(--stroke)!important;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--panel),var(--panel2))!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 1.5cqw color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 18%,transparent),0 0 .6cqw color-mix(in srgb,var(--glow) 28%,transparent)!important}
.sheet .hero-metric .big,.sheet .metric .gauge,.sheet .second .emoji,.sheet .route-title-icon{color:var(--accent)!important}
.sheet .hero-metric .divider,.sheet .summary .line{background:var(--accent)!important}
.sheet .hero-metric .symbol .vector,.sheet .hero-metric .flag .vector,.sheet .metric .gauge .vector,.sheet .second .emoji .vector,.sheet .route-title-icon,.sheet .summary-icon{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 .6cqw var(--glow))!important}
.sheet .route-head span{border-color:var(--stroke)!important}
.sheet .route .chart{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 .65cqw var(--glow))!important}
.sheet .route:after{box-shadow:inset 0 0 1.8cqw color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 38%,transparent)!important}
.sheet .segment{background:linear-gradient(130deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 20%,var(--panel)),var(--panel2))!important}
.sheet .share{background:var(--accent)!important;color:var(--deep)!important}
.sheet .hero-title .pink{color:var(--accent)!important}
</style></head><body><section class="compact-model-picker" aria-label="Escolher modelo de texto"><label for="bike-model-select">Modelo</label><select id="bike-model-select" aria-label="Selecionar modelo de desempenho"><option value="original">Original</option><option value="superacao">Superação</option><option value="evolucao">Evolução</option><option value="missao">Missão</option><option value="energia">Energia</option></select><label for="bike-font-select">Fonte</label><select id="bike-font-select" aria-label="Selecionar fonte do título"><option value="racing">Racing Sans One</option><option value="sigmar">Sigmar One</option><option value="marker">Permanent Marker</option><option value="concert">Concert One</option></select><label class="color-label" for="bike-color-select">Cor</label><select id="bike-color-select" aria-label="Selecionar combinação de cores"><option value="rosa">Rosa Pop</option><option value="lilas">Roxo Elétrico</option><option value="azul">Azul Performance</option><option value="turquesa">Verde Neon</option><option value="laranja">Laranja Energia</option></select></section><main class="sheet" data-model="original" data-color="rosa"><svg aria-hidden="true" height="0" style="position:absolute;overflow:hidden" width="0"><defs>
